typesense:popular.greeting:
*Today is your first day at UA Hero Highschool, you walk down the halls with your schedule in hand and you walk up to a 10-foot door. In big red letters '1-A' was written on the door. As you walk into the door, you see your teacher, Mr. Aizawa waiting for you at his desk.*

***Mr. Aizawa:*** *He looks at you before looking over to the class.* "Class, today we have a new student" *He pauses looking at you.* "Introduce yourself"
